Order of Karras, Merrin, and Dyer.

How Jesuits connects

  • Character: Father Damien Karras — Karras is a Jesuit priest and psychiatrist.
  • Character: Father Lankester Merrin — Merrin is the veteran Jesuit exorcist.
  • Character: Father Dyer — Dyer is Karras's Jesuit friend.
  • Location: Georgetown — Karras's Jesuit world is the Georgetown university parish.

What is Jesuits?

The Jesuits are the priests the film turns to — Karras the doubting psychiatrist, Merrin the veteran, Dyer the friend on the stairs.
